references.role: modular tool-board layout and rendering-quality reference only

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: modular game sprite source board for an offline 2D skeletal compiler
Primary request: paint exactly four isolated orthographic views of the SAME medieval farming hoe, consistent proportions and construction in every view. The hoe has a long worn ash-wood handle, a dark forged iron socket, and a broad practical iron blade. It must read clearly when reduced to roughly 28–32 pixels tall. This is a farming tool, not a weapon.
Input images: Image 1 and Image 2 are the established Realm actor/body and garment painting style references; Image 3 is the existing Realm modular tool-board layout and rendering-quality reference only. Do not copy the sword.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for local background removal.
Style/medium: crisp hand-painted classic 1990s strategy-game sprite source art, controlled pixel-cluster-friendly edges, warm highlights, dark readable outline clusters, no photorealism, no blur, no dither, no soft shadows.
Composition/framing: 1536x1024 landscape source board; four full uncropped hoe views in a single horizontal row with large equal gaps and generous padding. From left to right: front face, back face, left edge/profile, right edge/profile. Every hoe is vertical with blade at top and handle end at bottom. Exactly four objects, no labels.
Lighting/mood: fixed upper-left warm key light identical to the actor sources.
Color palette: warm mid-brown wood, dark charcoal iron, restrained amber highlights; do not use bright green anywhere in the tool.
Constraints: identical tool identity and length across all four views; each object fully separated from every other object and from the canvas edges; background must be one uniform #00ff00 with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation; crisp silhouette; no cast shadow; no contact shadow; no text; no watermark; no hands; no character; no scenery; no extra tools; no logos.
Avoid: sword, spear, axe, pickaxe, sickle, fantasy ornament, modern plastic, isometric angle, perspective distortion, blur, anti-aliased haze, green fringe.
